text:
Sean (AE): FYI — Zenith is ready to start a 2-week POC. They want us to onboard a new model variant 'medbert-v2-clinical' for entity extraction on long clinical notes. Need compatibility + quantization check + ballpark pricing for a Dedicated pool for 3 months. Timeline: start next Mon.
Priya (Solutions): Got it. Quick Qs: what's the expected max seq length and QPS? Are they doing any fine-tuning or only inference? Also do they require EU data residency?
Noah (ML Eng): They mentioned avg seq ~4k tokens, spikes to 8k; ~50 qps during peak of the POC (bursty). It's a decoder-only model? I asked, waiting on reply. For compatibility we need to run a model scan and a small perf pass (FP16 + int8 fallback). Example check: 
```bash
./model-inspector --model /sftp/zenith/medbert-v2-clinical --seq 4096 --warmup 100 --profile
```
That gives us memory, kernel compatibility, and whether KV cache is supported.
Linh (Product): Also need to know if they want pinning to a specific commit/hash or are OK with a Redwood-verified variant. We can offer a canary rollout (10% traffic) then 100% if perf OK. For 8k seqs we might need custom batching rules.
Jordan (Security): Heads-up: Zenith will require answers to an extended security questionnaire and insist on KMS-managed keys + audit logs retention 13 months. Please share the security questionnaire link and any sample completed answers. Also confirm whether model artifacts will be scanned for sensitive PII during upload.
Sean (AE): @Priya @Noah can we get the compatibility scan and a short SOW draft by Friday EOD? Zenith's procurement has a 2-week sign window once they see numbers. Also need a price for Dedicated reserved capacity vs hosted uplift for the POC (3 months). :calendar:
Priya (Solutions): Pricing back-of-envelope: Hosted API for this workload (long seqs) will be expensive per-token. Dedicated reserved monthly estimate (3-month commit) — list price approx $14k-$22k/month depending on GPU class and quantization. I'll firm it up after perf numbers. Will include optional SOC2 add-on and private VPC pricing.
Noah (ML Eng): Plan for the scan: 1) model-inspector pass 2) small inference run with typical prompts (2k/4k/8k) 3) quantize to int8 (if accuracy loss <2% on eval set) 4) perf profile. Expected outputs: memory footprint, peak latency P50/P95, token throughput, accuracy delta table. I'll drop artifacts into the POC S3 bucket + attach perf dashboard link via model-bot.
model-bot: Uploaded initial scan placeholder: https://s3.redwood/zenith/medbert-v2-clinical/scan-1.json (will update when full run completes)
Priya (Solutions): I'll draft the SOW template and include acceptance criteria: max P95 latency <600ms for 2k tokens, accuracy delta <2% on entity F1, and privacy checklist. Will also include a clause for automatic fallback to a smaller variant if P95 >1s.
Jordan (Security): For questionnaire: give them the standard Enterprise Security Pack v3.1 link: https://redwood.internal/security/questionnaire/v3.1 and I'll pre-fill KMS/retention answers. Also flagging that if they want on-prem private, timeline extends by ~3 weeks for network setup.
Sean (AE): Perfect. Next steps: Noah runs the scan by Wed, Priya sends SOW + pricing by Thu, Jordan pre-fills security questionnaire by Thu. I'll coordinate procurement sync on Friday. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Priya (Solutions): Adding action items in the thread. I'll ping if I need test data or eval prompts from Zenith.
Noah (ML Eng): Copy — prepping test harness. If anyone has a small representative sample (redacted) that mimics 8k sequences, push to the POC S3 bucket.
Jordan (Security): FYI — Zenith asked about certification docs. I'll attach SOC2 cert and SIG profile after I finish the questionnaire.
Sean (AE): Great — closing loop here. If any blocker pops up, drop it in #release-war-room or DM me.
